request.title: Reset your password.
request.description: Use your verified email and your current authenticator. Choose a new password without changing your authenticator.
email.hint: Enter the primary email you verified for this account.
request.hint: You will need a current six-digit code from your authenticator app.
sent.title: Check your email.
sent.description: If this email address belongs to an account, password reset instructions will arrive there.
sent.hint: Check your spam folder too. Open the link and have your authenticator app ready.
link.title: Continue password reset.
link.description: Continue when you are ready to choose a new password and enter a code from your current authenticator.
password.title: Choose a new password.
password.description: Enter your new password and one current authenticator code to finish.
password.label: New password
password.hint: Use at least {minimum} characters. A long, unique password is best.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
code.label: Current authenticator code
code.hint: Use the six-digit code for this account in your existing authenticator app. Spaces are accepted when pasting.
password.effect: This signs out previous sessions. Your authenticator and unused saved recovery codes stay valid.
done.title: Your password is reset.
done.description: Your new password is ready. Previous sessions have been signed out.
done.hint: Keep your existing authenticator entry and saved recovery codes. Wait for the next fresh authenticator code before logging in with your new password.
fallback.link: Recover with a saved recovery code
fallback.hint: Recover access with an unused saved recovery code.
fallback.switch: Close this password reset, then recover access with an unused saved recovery code.
fallback.pending: To use a saved recovery code instead, open this reset's email link and choose to switch recovery. If the link has expired, request fresh instructions.
fallback.unknown: We could not confirm that this reset was closed. Check its status again before switching to saved-code recovery.
cancel.title: Cancel this password reset?
cancel.description: Cancelling closes this request and keeps your current password and authenticator.
cancelled.title: Password reset cancelled.
cancelled.description: This request is closed. Your current password and authenticator remain in use.
expired.title: This password reset is no longer available.
expired.description: The link or session expired, was closed, or can no longer be used. Request a new link to try again.
error.code: That authenticator code was not accepted. Wait for a fresh code and try again.
error.code.format: Enter the six-digit code from your current authenticator.
error.password: The password does not meet the account's length limits.
error.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.unknown: We could not tell whether this worked. Check the reset status before trying again.
checked.hint: The reset is still open. Enter your new password and a fresh authenticator code to continue.
